## 🚀 Core Features

### 1. Intelligent Feature Planning

**What it does:** Automatically analyzes feature requests and creates comprehensive implementation plans

**Use Cases:**
- Product manager describes feature in natural language
- CORTEX generates step-by-step plan with timelines
- Identifies risks and dependencies before development starts
- Creates stakeholder-friendly documentation

**User Stories:**
- **As a** product manager, **I want** automatic planning so **I can** spend less time on documentation
- **As a** tech lead, **I want** risk analysis so **I can** identify blockers early
- **As a** stakeholder, **I want** clear timelines so **I can** plan releases

**Competitive Advantage:** 70% faster planning than manual processes

**Status:** ✅ Production Ready

---

### 2. Automated Quality Assurance

**What it does:** Ensures every code change has comprehensive tests and meets quality standards

**Use Cases:**
- Developer writes feature code
- CORTEX automatically generates tests
- Tests run before code review
- Quality gates prevent bugs from reaching production

**User Stories:**
- **As a** developer, **I want** auto-test generation so **I can** focus on features
- **As a** QA engineer, **I want** comprehensive coverage so **I can** trust releases
- **As a** product owner, **I want** quality enforcement so **I can** reduce production bugs

**Competitive Advantage:** 90%+ test coverage vs industry average 60-70%

**Status:** ✅ Production Ready

---

### 3. Self-Documenting Codebase

**What it does:** Automatically keeps documentation in sync with code changes

**Use Cases:**
- Developer makes code change
- CORTEX updates related documentation
- Stakeholders always see current state
- No documentation lag or drift

**User Stories:**
- **As a** product manager, **I want** current docs so **I can** track features accurately
- **As a** developer, **I want** auto-docs so **I don't** spend time writing them
- **As a** new team member, **I want** accurate docs so **I can** onboard quickly

**Competitive Advantage:** 95% reduction in documentation maintenance time

**Status:** 🚧 In Development (Phase 7)

---

### 4. Multi-Stakeholder Communication

**What it does:** Generates appropriate documentation for different audiences (technical, business, executive)

**Use Cases:**
- Engineering team completes feature
- CORTEX generates 3 versions of documentation:
  - Technical details for engineers
  - Business impact for product
  - Executive summary for leadership
- Everyone gets information in their language

**User Stories:**
- **As a** VP, **I want** executive summaries so **I can** understand impact quickly
- **As a** product manager, **I want** business language so **I can** communicate value
- **As a** developer, **I want** technical details so **I can** maintain code

**Competitive Advantage:** Eliminates translation time between stakeholders

**Status:** 🚧 In Development (Phase 7)

---

### 5. Code Sanitization for Sharing

**What it does:** Removes company-specific data to safely share code externally

**Use Cases:**
- Need to share code with consultants
- Open-sourcing internal tool
- Creating training materials
- Building portfolio

**User Stories:**
- **As a** hiring manager, **I want** sanitized samples so **I can** evaluate candidates
- **As a** consultant manager, **I want** safe sharing so **I can** protect IP
- **As a** developer, **I want** portfolio code so **I can** showcase skills

**Competitive Advantage:** Automated vs manual sanitization (10x faster)

**Status:** ✅ Production Ready

---

### 6. Azure DevOps Integration

**What it does:** Creates and manages work items (Stories, Features, Tasks) with proper formatting

**Use Cases:**
- Product manager defines feature
- CORTEX creates ADO work items
- Generates acceptance criteria
- Tracks completion

**User Stories:**
- **As a** product manager, **I want** auto-ADO creation so **I can** save time
- **As a** team lead, **I want** proper formatting so **I can** maintain standards
- **As a** stakeholder, **I want** tracking so **I can** monitor progress

**Competitive Advantage:** 80% faster work item creation

**Status:** ✅ Production Ready

---

### 7. System Health Monitoring

**What it does:** Continuously monitors codebase health and auto-fixes issues

**Use Cases:**
- Daily health checks
- Automatic alignment fixes
- Code cleanup recommendations
- Performance optimization

**User Stories:**
- **As a** tech lead, **I want** health monitoring so **I can** catch issues early
- **As a** developer, **I want** auto-fixes so **I don't** waste time on maintenance
- **As a** product owner, **I want** system reliability so **I can** plan with confidence

**Competitive Advantage:** Proactive vs reactive maintenance

**Status:** ✅ Production Ready

---

### 8. Codebase Discovery & Intelligence

**What it does:** Provides comprehensive codebase analysis and insights

**Use Cases:**
- New developer needs to understand codebase
- Planning refactoring work
- Finding duplicate code
- Understanding dependencies

**User Stories:**
- **As a** new developer, **I want** codebase overview so **I can** understand structure quickly
- **As a** architect, **I want** dependency analysis so **I can** plan refactoring
- **As a** tech lead, **I want** duplicate detection so **I can** improve code quality

**Competitive Advantage:** Automated discovery vs manual exploration (20x faster)

**Status:** 🚧 In Development (Phases 1-6)

## 💡 Use Case Library

### Use Case 1: Fast Feature Planning

**Scenario:** Product manager needs to plan authentication feature

**Without CORTEX:**
1. Research similar features (4 hours)
2. Write planning document (6 hours)
3. Create technical spec (4 hours)
4. Estimate timeline (2 hours)
5. Create ADO work items (2 hours)
**Total:** 18 hours

**With CORTEX:**
1. Describe feature in natural language (15 min)
2. CORTEX generates comprehensive plan (5 min)
3. Review and adjust (30 min)
4. CORTEX creates ADO items (2 min)
**Total:** 52 minutes (95% time savings)

---

### Use Case 2: Quality Enforcement

**Scenario:** Developer implements payment processing feature

**Without CORTEX:**
1. Write feature code (8 hours)
2. Manually write tests (4 hours)
3. Code review finds missing tests (2 hours)
4. Add more tests (2 hours)
5. QA finds bugs (4 hours)
**Total:** 20 hours + bugs in production

**With CORTEX:**
1. Write feature code (8 hours)
2. CORTEX auto-generates tests (5 min)
3. Run TDD validation (5 min)
4. Pass code review first time (1 hour)
5. QA validates (1 hour)
**Total:** 10 hours + no production bugs (50% time savings)

---

### Use Case 3: Onboarding New Developer

**Scenario:** New developer joins team

**Without CORTEX:**
1. Read outdated docs (2 days)
2. Ask team questions (3 days)
3. Explore codebase manually (5 days)
4. Build mental model (10 days)
**Total:** 20 days to productivity

**With CORTEX:**
1. Run discovery on codebase (5 min)
2. Review auto-generated overview (2 hours)
3. Follow interactive guidance (1 day)
4. Ask targeted questions (1 day)
**Total:** 2 days to productivity (90% faster)

## 🆘 Getting Started

### For Product Managers
1. Try planning feature: `plan [feature name]`
2. Generate ADO work items: `plan ado story`
3. Review auto-generated docs: `cortex discover`

### For Developers
1. Start TDD workflow: `start tdd`
2. Run health check: `healthcheck`
3. Explore codebase: `cortex discover src/`

### For Managers
1. View dashboard: `cortex dashboard`
2. Check metrics: `cortex metrics`
3. Generate executive report: `cortex discover --audience leadership`
